title: Headings & Hobbies
description: Build a small page about yourself using headings and paragraphs correctly.
problemStatement:
Create a personal bio page named `about-me.html`.

**Requirements:**
- Use `<h1>` for your name as the main title.
- Use `<h2>` for a section called **"My Hobbies"**.
- Under that, list three hobbies using `<h3>` headings, each followed by a short paragraph describing why you enjoy that hobby.
- Add an HTML comment above the hobbies section explaining its purpose.

Make sure all tags are properly opened and closed, and your code is neatly indented.
hints: Start with the basic HTML skeleton you practiced in task 1.
An `<h2>` can contain multiple `<h3>` subsections – that’s perfectly valid.
Comments don’t appear on the page but help you remember why you added something.
expectedOutput: A well‑structured page with a main heading (your name), a subheading 'My Hobbies', and three hobby subsections with paragraphs. The source code should contain a comment before the hobbies section.
solutionCode:
Alex Rivera
